rationale: Internally consistent and coverage-motivated, but it is a one-variable swap (che/lct for oancf/lct) inside the already-tested MIN(after-tax operating yield, liquidity leg) template from generation 7, i.e. a cosmetic variant rather than a new mechanism, and substituting a static cash stock for the cash-realization channel removes precisely the corroboration that drove the earlier alpha.

The multiplicative weighting is a genuinely different functional form from the archive's MIN-based deficit/cash-collapse conjunction, the non-negative RANK weight preserves the signed direction so the expression matches the stated hypothesis and negative sign, and coverage should improve; the main caveat is that IND_ZSCORE recenters at the industry mean, so the claimed "no signal when cash flow is unchanged" neutral point is only approximate.

The dimensional-coherence critique of the earlier funding-gap subtraction is legitimate and the expression matches the hypothesis, but the construction simply re-pairs two already-tested archive legs (post-dividend cash-flow yield and the net-working-capital ratio from the generation-0 signal) inside the same MIN template while inheriting the dvc/oancf coverage constraint of ~0.08.

This is the most substantive departure in the batch — replacing raw asset contraction with valuation-scaled asset-turnover improvement is an economically distinct channel and the cash-cushion leg is well motivated — though the reviewer should note that change in asset turnover is itself a published DuPont-decomposition anomaly (Soliman), so the novelty rests entirely on the valuation scaling and the cash conjunction.

The expression does encode the stated trap, but it loads positively on dividend yield — a leg the archive shows carries a weakly positive return slope — while expecting a negative overall sign, so the two components pull against each other, and the second leg is the exact negation of the generation-6 residual-cash dividend signal, making net direction and incremental content ambiguous.

Both legs have already been tested in the archive and both failed in this direction — lct/lt produced a wrong-signed positive alpha in the generation-4 concentration trap and the market-scaled cash-flow decline was insignificant in generation 7 — so mechanically MIN-ing two known-weak components inside the same template offers little reason to expect improvement, and oancf still caps coverage near 0.08.
